## Privacy / Security Impact

## Copyright / Source-Material Impact

Does this involve EPUBs, fanfiction, dictionary data, copied text, screenshots, or other source material?

## Non-Goals

What should this not become?

Interleaf Reader is reading-first. It is not a flashcard/drill app, generic translator, public translation library, or AO3 scraper.

Chinese Reading Mode, Mixed Mode, and translation providers are planned/placeholders unless implemented in a future scoped milestone.
